name: Cupid Ltd
about: Established in 1993, CUPID Limited is India's premier manufacturer of male and female condoms, personal lubricant, and IVD kits.[1]
keyPoints:
Products Offered[1]
The Co. manufactures male condoms, female condoms, water-based lubricant jelly, IVD products such as Pregnancy Test Kits, Covid 19 Antigen Test Kit, HIV Test Kit, Dengue test kits, Malaria antigen test kits, etc.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Promoter holding has increased by 3.04% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 23.7 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.70% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 36.1% of their holding.
Debtor days have increased from 98.2 to 134 days.
Working capital days have increased from 137 days to 210 days
